nodes.title: Real-line tightness implies tightness

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a space carrying a σ-algebra and a topology. A family $(\mu_i)_{i \in \iota}$ of probability measures on $\alpha$ is tight exactly when its range $\{\mu_i : i \in \iota\}$ is a tight set of measures.
nodes.title: Tightness of a family is tightness of its range

nodes.summary: For every index type $\iota$ and every probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}$, the constant family $(\mu)_{i \in \iota}$ is tight.
nodes.title: Constant families on the real line are tight

nodes.title: Tight families on the real line concentrate on bounded intervals

nodes.summary: A family $(\mu_i)_{i \in \iota}$ of probability measures on $\mathbb{R}$ is tight in the real-line sense if for every $\varepsilon \in (0, \infty]$ there is $M \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $\mu_i([-M, M]) \ge 1 - \varepsilon$ for every index $i$.
nodes.title: Tightness on the real line

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a space carrying a σ-algebra and a topology. A family $(\mu_i)_{i \in \iota}$ of probability measures on $\alpha$ is tight if its range $\{\mu_i : i \in \iota\}$ is a tight set of measures: for every $\varepsilon \in (0, \infty]$ there is a compact set $K \subseteq \alpha$ such that $\mu_i(\alpha \setminus K) \le \varepsilon$ for every index $i$.
nodes.title: Tight family of probability measures

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
